bio.text: Helen Qiu is the Republican candidate for New York State Assembly District 65 in the November 3, 2026 general election, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Zhongshan University in 1990, a graduate degree from the Reformed Seminary in 2007, and a graduate degree from Columbia University in 2010.
Her career experience includes working as a pastor, teacher, engineer and engineering manager.
